subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this stacked draft remain the live Telegram proof target, and what proof is sufficient before either the stack or the split PRs can move forward?
rationale: The code path is source-reproducible, but the available Mantis artifact did not start the generated-image proof scenario, and deciding whether scheduler-level proof is enough is a maintainer proof policy choice.

options.title: Require working stacked Telegram proof
options.body: Keep the draft open but non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, logs, or live output shows main missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one generated image.

options.title: Accept internal-path proof instead
options.body: Maintainers can accept scheduler-level or internal Mantis proof for this hard-to-expose path and keep the final code landing split across the two narrower PRs.

options.title: Close the proof stack
options.body: If the proof runner cannot exercise the scenario or the stack has served its purpose, close this draft and continue with the split implementation and harness PRs.

recommendation.title: Require working stacked Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open but non-landing until a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, logs, or live output shows main missing or blocking the marker image and the candidate delivering exactly one generated image.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is mainly about Telegram/Mantis proof harness reliability, and this person has recent history on the relevant proof workflow files.
